chunks: Mūsā ibn Bakr narrated from Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام, who said:

key_terms.أَبِي ٱلْحَسَنِ: A kunyah referring here to Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام
key_terms.بِٱلزَّكَاةِ: By means of zakat, the obligatory alms-tax

ai.seo_question: How does zakat protect a person's wealth in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers to protect and fortify their wealth by giving zakat. It presents zakat not merely as a financial obligation, but as a means of safeguarding one's property through obedience to Allah.
